llm.label: ML & NLP papers
llm.note: 36 arXiv papers. Calibrated: at 0.0 the gate wrongly refuses 1 of 67 answerable questions (1.5%) and catches 9 of 17 adversarial. Lowering costs more catching than it recovers here, which is why this corpus kept the value the whole project was built on. Candidate pool: 16 is weakly dominant here: any-hit unchanged, MRR +0.1, NDCG +0.2, source recall +0.1, and 25% less reranking. Measured 2026-08-27 by src/sweep_candidates.py.

birds.label: Ornithology
birds.note: 45 Wikipedia documents, mixed .docx/.pptx/.xlsx/.pdf. Recalibrated 2026-08-26 and the reason it moved is worth more than the value: -3.0 was derived from confidences measured at rerank blend 0.00, and this corpus ships 0.20, so the gate had been calibrated against a pipeline the server does not run. Re-measured on the served pipeline, -3.0 is dominated. Every threshold in (-6.48, -4.55] catches the same six of seven adversarial cases and wrongly refuses two of twenty-five rather than three, recovering bird-incubation for nothing. -5.5 is the middle of that interval: 0.95 of margin before it refuses an answerable question, 0.98 before it stops catching an adversarial one. An edge of the interval fits the threshold to one case. For scale, the ML papers' 0.0 wrongly refuses nine of the twenty-five here. What this does NOT fix: bird-dawn-chorus at -10.68 and bird-imprinting at -8.28 are questions whose answer the pipeline retrieved into the top five and whose passage the cross-encoder then scored below three of the six adversarial cases. No threshold recovers those without losing catches -- that is the reranker's calibration, not the gate's. Reranking keeps 20% of the first stage's ordering here (rerank_blend), which the other two corpora measured worse with: any-hit 0.808 -> 0.846 and MRR 0.570 -> 0.613, against -1.5 and -2.9 any-hit on the ML and quant sets at the same weight, all measured 2026-08-26 against the golden set as it then stood. On 25 cases the any-hit gain is one question, so MRR is the more trustworthy half of that. Candidate pool: 20, not the 16 the other two ship. At 16 this corpus keeps its any-hit and loses 2.6 points of MRR and 1.7 of NDCG, so the 22% saved is bought from ranking quality. The pool ceiling here also rises fastest with size -- 0.885 at 20 against 0.962 at 28 -- and this is the corpus whose reranker is weakest, which is the same story from the other end.

quant.label: Quantitative finance
quant.note: 35 arXiv q-fin papers. Recalibrated 2026-08-26 and recounted 2026-09-01 after two questions the corpus does not answer moved to the adversarial half: -6, -5 and -4 all catch the same seven of eight adversarial cases and wrongly refuse the same one of thirty-three, so the shipped -4 stands. At 0.0 it would refuse nine. -3 catches the eighth and refuses a second answerable question, which is the trade this project declines, since a false refusal is the costlier error. An earlier note reported nineteen refusals at 0.0, measured against the golden set as it stood before 2026-08-26, which asked textbook definitional questions this corpus never answers. Those questions scored low because they were unanswerable, not because the threshold was wrong. Answerable questions now score a median of +2.81, against +2.72 before two unanswerable questions were reclassified on 2026-09-01, -0.38 before the golden set was rewritten, and +2.34 before the second dense retriever. Candidate pool: 16 is weakly dominant here too, and by more than on the ML set: MRR +2.9, NDCG +1.5, any-hit and source recall unchanged, 21% less reranking. Second dense retriever: bge-small-en-v1.5, fused by RRF alongside dense and BM25. Measured end to end 2026-08-28 against the golden set as it then stood: MRR 0.743 -> 0.779, NDCG 0.764 -> 0.786, source recall 0.741 -> 0.769, any-hit unchanged at 0.886. Those four figures predate the 2026-09-01 reclassification and have not been re-measured, so read them as the size of the effect rather than as current scores. Enabled here and NOT on the other two: the ML papers lose 0.030 of any-hit and every other metric with it, and birds gains a question of any-hit while losing MRR, which this project reads as the less trustworthy half on 25 cases.
